trackerLog.subject: Asteria
trackerLog.focus: Thirteen acts. Act 7 cataclysm. Acts 8-11 open world. Acts 12-13 rails to Deep Fissure ending.

feature.notes: Act 6 no longer previews an Act 7 ending. Choice preview only. Ending is Act 13.

feature.title: Act 7 — World Cannon, Maze Fissure mouth, cataclysm
feature.notes: Locations stand. Not the ending. Vortan fires or is one latch short. Cataclysm opens the Deep Fissure and wrecks the north. Party is thrown back to the scarred overworld. Airship becomes free. See FEAT-039 through FEAT-045.
Single ending plays in Act 13 inside the Deep Maze Fissure, after Act 7's cataclysm and the Act 8-11 open world. Thesis unchanged: Nyxara sealed, Cannon spiked as a plug, world scarred and standing.
Board pack is now Act 0 through Act 13 (FEAT-013..020, FEAT-039..044). Do not board the old eight-act cut.

set.notes: Thirteen acts. Storyboard: FEAT-013-020 and FEAT-039-044. Open-world container FEAT-045. Ending FEAT-037 on Act 13.

feature.title: Act 8 — Open world: polities and recovery
feature.notes: First open-world chapter after the cataclysm. Airship hub. Towns, rails, levies, reconstruction. Order vs Acts 9-11 is free.

feature.title: Act 9 — Open world: temple circuit
feature.notes: Optional rebound of cracked Sigils at all six temples. Player chooses order. Side delves and aspect hunts. Not on rails.

feature.title: Act 10 — Open world: remnants
feature.notes: Velith remnant, Vortan hunt, Invasion diaspora, Bengenia wreck-isle if wiped. Lots of side boards. Not the ending.

feature.title: Act 11 — Open world: personal quests and Deep key
feature.notes: Last-call side content. Alive main-side personal quests. Song-duel and brass cards finales. Key that opens Act 12.

feature.title: Act 12 — Rails resume: approach to the Deep Fissure
feature.notes: Open world locks. Forced approach through the Cannon wreck and Fissure mouth. Mid confrontations only. No ending here.

feature.title: Act 13 — Rails: Deep Maze Fissure and single ending
feature.notes: Deeper dungeon opened by the Act 7 cataclysm. Nyxara. Single ending (FEAT-037). Suggestive Cael/Liraen beat after the seal.

feature.title: Post-cataclysm open world (Acts 8-11)
feature.notes: After Act 7 the master map is freely flyable. Acts 8-11 are chapter boards inside that map, any internal order. Act 12 starts when the Deep key exists. Side content is the point of this block.

trackerLog.decision: Thirteen acts, Act 0 through Act 13. Act 7 is the cataclysm at World Cannon / Maze Fissure mouth, not the ending.
Acts 8-11 are open world with heavy side content. Play order among those four is free. Airship is the hub.
Acts 12-13 are on rails. The single ending is Act 13 in the Deep Maze Fissure opened by the Act 7 cataclysm.
